notes.title: New game from the Inspector Waffles' creator!
notes.content: [p]Well, "new game" ... It all started in 2019 when I did a small project called Antenna Dilemma, just before I made Inspector Waffles (the one from 2021). I put on Antenna Dilemma on hold for quite some time, and now, I'm going to finish and release it :)[/p][p][/p][p]If you don't know, Antenna Dilemma is a witty point-and-click adventure game in which you'll follow the story of C432632, a finicky grey cube that sure doesn't want to miss his favorite TV show.[/p][p]In a media-driven society in which nothing else matters but TV, our hero is about to have a life-changing encounter. Gone are the sofa and the remote control: for the first time of his life, C432632 is about to break out of his routine and set off, against his will, on an epic adventure.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853730/Antenna_Dilemma?snr=2___"]You can add Antenna Dilemma to your wishlist here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't, you can play the prologue, free on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support,[/p][p][/p][p]Yann[/p]

notes.title: New aspect ratio and minor fixes in UI!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Took me a little while, but the game is finally updated in its (probably) final form.
Here a list of things I fixed:

* Screen ratio! You can now play in 16:9, 4:3 or native (it's really small, be prepared!)
* A couple of translation fixes in the french UI 
* Some UI Buttons didn't have the correct text

The ROM can't be changed or you'll all lose your saves, so.... sorry for the typos I can't fix anymore.

Take care and see you soon for new games,

Yann

notes.title: Inspector Waffles Early Days is out!
notes.content:
🚨INSPECTOR WAFFLES EARLY DAYS IS OUT! 🚨

Find clues, interrogate cats of interest, solve cases and become the best detective in this new retro adventure game featuring Inspector Waffles. 🐱🕵️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614580/Inspector_Waffles_Early_Days/

notes.title: Inspector Waffles Early Days Release Date: November 15!
notes.content:
The wait is over. Three years later, Waffles is finally back in a new retro adventure.🐱🕵️

[b]Inspector Waffles Early Days will be released on November 15th on Steam.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614580/Inspector_Waffles_Early_Days/

Thanks for your support through the years, Waffles has been part of my life for the last seven years, and I'm super happy to finally share this new story. I hope you'll like it too :)

Take care ! 

Yann
